Notes from a slow week

I did not plan to write anything this week, but the workshop flooded on Tuesday and I spent three days moving boxes of paper from the low shelves to the high ones, which turns out to be an excellent way of finding everything you had forgotten you owned, including a complete run of a magazine I was certain I had given away. Most of it was dry, a little of it was not, and there are drying racks standing in every room of the house.

So this is a short post about what was in the boxes, and a longer thank-you to the neighbours who turned up with a pump before I had even worked out where the water was coming from, and who refused to take anything for it except a cup of tea and a look at the old press. One of them has already asked whether he can come back and print something on it before the winter.
